json-pointer.name: JSON Pointer Resolver
json-pointer.description: Extract one exact JSON value with RFC 6901 pointers or URI fragments, preserving large numbers locally.

meta.title: JSON Pointer Resolver
meta.description: Extract one exact JSON value with RFC 6901 pointers or URI fragments, preserving large numbers locally.
meta.keywords: JSON Pointer, RFC 6901, URI fragment, JSON reference, extract JSON

jsonPointer.hint: Empty or # selects the root. Use / for an empty key, ~1 for / and ~0 for ~. URI fragments such as #/a%20b are also accepted.
jsonPointer.limits: Limits: {input} UTF-16 units of JSON, {pointer} of pointer text, and {depth} nesting levels.
jsonPointer.emptyResult: Enter JSON and a pointer, then resolve to see the value.
jsonPointer.rules: Array indices start at 0; leading zeros and - are invalid for arrays. Object keys are exact and case-sensitive; whitespace is preserved. Strings remain JSON-quoted. Duplicate object keys are rejected; numbers retain their original precision.
jsonPointer.invalidJson: Invalid JSON. Check quotes, commas and brackets.
jsonPointer.duplicateKey: Duplicate object keys are ambiguous. Use unique keys throughout the document.
jsonPointer.inputLimit: JSON must not exceed {input} UTF-16 units.
jsonPointer.depthLimit: JSON must not exceed {depth} nesting levels.
jsonPointer.pointerLimit: Pointer text must not exceed {pointer} UTF-16 units.
jsonPointer.invalidFragment: Invalid URI fragment: check percent escapes and UTF-8 encoding.
jsonPointer.invalidPointer: A pointer must be empty or begin with /. A URI fragment must begin with #.
jsonPointer.invalidEscape: Step {step}: ~ must be followed by 0 or 1.
jsonPointer.missingKey: Step {step}: this object has no matching key.
jsonPointer.invalidIndex: Step {step}: use an array index of 0 or a positive integer without leading zeros; - is not an existing element.
jsonPointer.indexRange: Step {step}: array index is out of bounds.
jsonPointer.scalarTraversal: Step {step}: cannot descend into a scalar or null value.
jsonPointer.outputLimit: Formatted output exceeds {output} UTF-16 units. Select a smaller value.
